name: Tamun
source:
Tamun admires strength and confidence, but she’s just as fond of good wine and good company. Spend enough time with her, and you may find her bite isn’t nearly as dangerous as her charm.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4014730/Harem_of_Ankhutep/]Steam[/url]]
